qualification.note: This is a research gate, not proof of profitability. Qualification is based on the unchanged production SETUP LONG threshold of 75, not the train-selected threshold.

methodology.entry: next candle open, after signal candle has closed
methodology.exit: open 16 x 15m bars after entry; 4-hour holding period
methodology.costs: 15/20/25 bps round-trip sensitivity; 15 bps primary proxy (assumption, not exchange-specific fee quote)
methodology.thresholdSelection: training-only non-overlapping per-symbol net expectancy, minimum 100 training trades; OOS threshold is diagnostic only and cannot qualify production
methodology.overlapPolicy: primary event metric enforces no overlapping positions per symbol; different symbols can overlap, so aggregate statistics are signal-quality diagnostics, not a capital-constrained portfolio backtest
methodology.purge: training trades must exit before OOS starts; OOS trades must exit before OOS ends
methodology.calibration: score buckets are overlapping event diagnostics; do not treat as portfolio returns
methodology.folds: rolling 12-month training window and 3-month OOS windows, stepped by 3 months
